title: RppH can faithfully replace TAP to allow cloning of 5′-triphosphate carrying small RNAs
author: Almeida, de Jesus Domingues, et al.
materials: For synchronization, gravid adult worm populations were bleached and eggs were allowed to hatch overnight in M9 buffer, at 20 °C. steps.title: Grow and synchronize C. elegans
steps.instruction: Cultivate wild‑type N2 worms at 20 °C on NGM plates seeded with E. coli OP50; bleach gravid adults, hatch eggs overnight in M9 at 20 °C, then plate synchronized L1 larvae on OP50 plates and grow 60–63 h at 20 °C to adulthood.

steps.title: Harvest and lyse adult worms
steps.instruction: Wash adult worms off plates with M9 buffer, resuspend in 250 µL Worm Lysis Buffer (0.2 M NaCl, 0.1 M Tris pH 8.5, 50 mM EDTA, 0.5 % SDS) containing 150 µg Proteinase K, incubate ≥30 min at 65 °C.

steps.title: Extract total RNA with Trizol LS
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL Trizol LS per sample, perform RNA extraction following the manufacturer’s protocol, using phase‑lock tubes to aid phase separation.

steps.title: Treat RNA with TURBO DNase
steps.instruction: Apply TURBO DNase (Life Technologies #AM1907) to the extracted RNA according to the supplier’s instructions.

steps.title: Isolate small RNAs using MirVana
steps.instruction: Purify small RNAs from the DNase‑treated total RNA with the MirVana kit (Life Technologies #AM1561) following the kit protocol.

steps.title: Size‑select 16–30 nt RNAs by PAGE
steps.instruction: Run the small‑RNA preparation on a 15 % TBE‑Urea polyacrylamide gel, excise the 16–30 nt band, and recover RNA.

substeps.instruction: Cut out the band corresponding to 16–30 nt.

steps.title: Precipitate recovered RNA
steps.instruction: Precipitate the gel‑extracted RNA using sodium chloride/isopropanol precipitation.

steps.title: Prepare library with modified adapters
steps.instruction: Use the NEBNext Multiplex Small RNA Library Prep Set for Illumina (v2.0 8/13) but replace the standard RNA‑ligation adapters with adapters that contain four random bases at their 3′ ends (synthesized by Bioo Scientific).

steps.title: Amplify library with PCR
steps.instruction: Perform 14 cycles of PCR amplification of the ligated library.

steps.title: Purify PCR product with AMPure beads
steps.instruction: Clean the PCR‑amplified cDNA using AMPure XP magnetic beads (Beckman Coulter).

steps.title: Size‑select final library on LabChip
steps.instruction: Run the purified library on a Perkin Elmer LabChip XT using the DNA 300 assay kit and collect the 135–170 bp fraction.
